invariant: owner_cut_i + alpha_out_i_remainder == original alpha_out_i (single take, no double-deduction)
note: S2 check: only one take off alpha_out_i before remainder flows to server/validator split. Clean.

invariant: pending_server + pending_validator + root_alpha == alpha_out_i (after owner_cut). Requires root_proportion <= 1.
note: S2 check: 3-way split is algebraically correct when root_proportion in [0,1]. Need to verify root_proportion() bound separately (see SITE 2b).

invariant: root_proportion in [0,1] — required for 3-way split to be non-negative
note: S5 check: root_proportion derived from EMA price ratio, expected [0,1] by dtao design. If ever > 1 (multi-subnet EMA sum > 1), pending_validator saturates to 0 and root_alpha inflates. Not checked here — requires runtime analysis of root_proportion() function.

invariant: tou64(alpha_take) + tou64(alpha_divs_remainder) == original alpha_divs (up to 1 rao rounding)
note: S3: double floor truncation loses up to 1 rao per hotkey per epoch. Rounding-to-dust, documented behavior in fixed-point. Not a value-creation bug — value is lost, not created.

invariant: tou64(alpha_take) + tou64(root_alpha_remainder) == original root_alpha (up to 1 rao rounding)
note: S3: identical double-floor truncation pattern to SITE 3. 1 rao max rounding loss per hotkey. Not value creation.
S2 check: root_prop = root_alpha / total_alpha, total_alpha includes root_alpha → root_prop < 1 always. alpha_divs = dividend - root_divs → exact conservation.

invariant: Σ prop_alpha_for_hotkey ≤ pending_alpha; deficit ≤ n_hotkeys (rounding loss)
witness: 100 hotkeys, 1B pending → deficit up to 100 rao per epoch
note: S3: proportional re-normalization with floor truncation; deficit bounded by hotkey count. Standard rounding dust. Not value creation.

invariant: burn_take + child_take ≤ parent_emission (takes computed off same base, saturation masks over-deduction)
witness: burn_rate=u64::MAX, child_take=u16::MAX: child gets child_take from nothing after parent saturates to 0
note: S1+S2: this is the previously found childkey bug (CANDIDATES.md). Re-confirmed by re-reading source.

invariant: remaining_emission ≥ 0 (doesn't saturate unless self_contribution=0); Σ parent_emissions ≤ validating_emission
note: S1 check: emission_factors sum to < 1 (self_contribution included in denominator), so remaining_emission stays non-negative. Conservation of parent portion is sound. The only breakage is from burn+child_take (SITE 7).

invariant: lock_reduction_interval > 0 (else lock cost never decreases, subnet lock permanent)
witness: block_emission=1 rao: halved_interval=0 → safe_div returns 0 → lock never expires
note: S3: truncating halving of lock_reduction_interval can produce 0. When 0, safe_div returns 0, so reduction=0, lock is permanent. Not a value creation bug — it's value-lock (liveness). Only reachable at extreme halving depths. Classified as intended/known quirk.

invariant: increment = amount / total_root_stake > 0 when amount > 0 (non-zero credit)
witness: amount=1 rao, total_root_stake>4294967296 rao: increment rounds to 0 in I96F32 (32 frac bits)
note: S3: round-to-zero for tiny emissions / large stake. Value loss (not creation). Practically unreachable at typical epoch sizes (millions of rao per epoch). Classified as intended rounding.

invariant: add_stake then remove_stake roundtrip leaves root_claimed unchanged
note: S1 check: both add and remove compute claimable_rate * amount with same truncation → exact roundtrip. If rate changes between calls, diff arises by design (pro-rata accumulation).

invariant: U96F32 dividend accumulation does not overflow (max sum << U96F32_MAX)
note: S4 check: no overflow possible given u64-bounded inputs and U96F32 capacity.

invariant: validator_alpha + root_alpha + owner_cut ≤ total_alpha_out (conservation holds when incentive_sum=0)
note: S2 check: when incentive_sum=0, server_alpha is rolled into validator_alpha. Total still == pending_server + pending_validator + pending_root + owner_cut = total_alpha_out. No value creation.

invariant: Σ subnet_emissions == block_emission when ≥1 subnet enabled
witness: All subnets disabled: total_emitted=0, block_emission lost (recycled via recycle_credit)
note: S5 check: when all subnets disabled, block emission goes to no subnet and is recycled by recycle_credit fallback in inject_and_maybe_swap. Design intent. Not value creation.

invariant: validator take (to hotkey coldkey) + nominator share (to pool) == original alpha_divs
note: S2 check: alpha_take → update_value_for_one (coldkey specific), alpha_divs_rem → update_value_for_all (nominators). Two different pool ops, no double-credit. Total hotkey alpha increase = alpha_divs (up to 1 rao floor).

invariant: owed = claimable - root_claimed ≥ 0 (negative → owed_u64=0, safe no-op)
note: S1 check: signed I96F32 subtraction with negative result guarded to 0. No value creation possible.
